paper.title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
paper.arxiv_title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction

source.caption: \small \textbf{Standard autoregressive modeling (AR) vs. our proposed visual autoregressive modeling (VAR).} (a) AR applied to language: sequential text token generation from left to right, word by word; (b) AR applied to images: sequential visual token generation in a raster-scan order, from left to right, top to bottom; (c) VAR for images: multi-scale token maps are autoregressively generated from coarse to fine scales (lower to higher resolutions), with parallel token generation within each scale. VAR requires a multi-scale VQVAE to work. \vspace{-12pt}
